task: Design critique of the Write tab (Director's Console) found real gaps (Critical dirty-loss issue already fixed in parallel work — not touched here). Fixed all 4 Warning items and the note-level copy sweep in one contained pass: Write mode's produced-chapter entry was gated behind a redundant 'Edit Text' -> 'Edit Anyway' click-through when the commit-time ResyncPreviewModal is the real safety net; no Discard action once unlocked; zero rail-tooltip disambiguation between Write/Revise; the 'RENDERED' eyebrow read as text-rendering jargon instead of a consequence ('is the audio done'); several voice-tone.md deviations (ASCII '...', spaced hyphens, sentence-case buttons, misleading 'Assignment-safe edit mode' label).

frontend/src/pages/Book/components/Chapt.summary: Added a `variant?: 'gated' | 'immediate'` prop (default `'gated'`, preserving Contents/Manuscript-stage behavior unchanged). `'immediate'` (used only by WriteTool) makes the textarea editable the instant a produced chapter mounts — no 'Edit Text'/'Edit Anyway' click-through — and swaps the produced-chapter strip for a new calm `chapter-text-panel__info-banner` ('Editing the full source. Committing re-syncs voice assignments — you'll preview what's kept before anything changes.') instead of the alarming warning-tint strip. Added a Discard button beside Commit Changes in the footer (`handleDiscard` resets text to `chapterText.chapter.text_content` and, for the gated variant, re-locks back to read-only); both buttons disabled when there are no uncommitted changes or a resync/commit is in flight. Added `eyebrowLabel()` mapping the raw `ChapterLifecycle` enum to consequence-aware wording for this surface only (Rendered->'Audio rendered', Cast->'Audio in progress' [Cast is actually the in-progress/partial state per deriveChapterLifecycle], Stale->'Needs re-render', Error->'Render error', Draft/Ready unchanged) — ChapterTable's status pill keeps the raw enum, untouched. Copy sweep (voice-tone.md): 'Edit text'/'Edit anyway'/'Commit changes' -> Title Case; 'saving...'/'Start typing...' -> '…'; 'editing - autosaved' -> em dash; 'autosave failed' -> sentence case; spaced-hyphen in the warning copy -> em dash; renamed the misleading 'Assignment-safe edit mode' strip to 'Changes aren't saved until you commit them.' (kept for the gated variant only).

frontend/src/pages/ChapterEditor/compone.summary: WriteToolBody now wraps `ChapterTextPanel` in a `.write-tool` container with a muted one-line subtitle ('Full-chapter editor · commits re-sync voice assignments') and passes `variant="immediate"`. Added `description: 'Write — rewrite the whole chapter (voices re-synced on commit)'` to the exported `WriteTool` registration for the rail tooltip. `onSaved`/`onDirtyChange` wiring to DirtyGuardContext is unchanged.
Added optional `description?: string` to `DirectorsTool` — richer rail-tooltip copy, falls back to `label` when omitted.

Rail button `title` now reads `tool.description ?? tool.label` (richer tooltip copy); `aria-label` stays `tool.label` (short accessible name, unchanged) so screen readers aren't forced to read a full sentence on every focus.

Adds Revise's tooltip description via `{ ...ReviseTool, description: 'Revise — fix one segment (other audio untouched)' }` in the registry array — deliberately done here rather than editing ReviseTool/index.tsx, which is out of scope per the task's do-not-touch list.

frontend/src/theme/components.css.summary: Added `.chapter-text-panel__info-banner` (calm accent-tint banner for Write mode's persistent entry notice, distinct from the warning-tint `.chapter-text-panel__unlock-strip`). Changed `.chapter-text-panel__footer` from `justify-content: space-between` to `flex-end` with a tighter gap now that Discard+Commit Changes form one paired action group. Added `.write-tool`/`.write-tool__hint` (mirrors the existing `.revise-tool`/`.revise-tool__hint` pattern) so the new WriteTool subtitle wrapper lays out and sizes correctly.

frontend/tests/unit/pages/Book/ChapterTe.summary: Updated existing assertions for the Title-Case button renames ('Edit Text'/'Edit Anyway'/'Commit Changes'). Added: a Discard test (resets text to original, re-locks the gated variant); a disabled-when-no-changes test for Discard/Commit Changes; an immediate-variant test (no Edit Text/warning alert, persistent info banner text present, edit+commit flow still previews resync); a gated-variant-default regression test confirming Contents/Manuscript's original click-through is unchanged.

flow_impact: ChapterTextPanel's prop contract grew (`variant`, default-preserving) — its two other call sites (ContentsStage.tsx, ManuscriptStage.tsx) pass no `variant` and keep today's gated behavior verbatim (verified by grep + the new gated-variant regression test). DirectorsTool's `description` field is additive/optional — no existing tool registration breaks. Cast/Booth/ReviseTool/index.tsx, DirtyGuardContext.tsx, and AppShell/player-bar CSS were not modified, per the task's do-not-touch list. Deferred: the player-bar-occlusion issue flagged in the critique (explicitly out of scope for this pass, needs an AppShell-level ResizeObserver fix).
